data.name: Fareeq
data.gender_notes: Fareeq is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'Faraa' which means 'to distinguish' or 'to separate'. It implies distinction and nobility. The name Fareeq carries the meaning “Distinguished, Noble” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Fareeq usually hope their child will grow to embody distinguished, noble and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, Fareeq symbolizes one who strives for righteousness and distinction, reflecting the virtues of leadership, courage, and wisdom.
data.etymology: Fareeq belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Distinguished, Noble.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fareeq total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: فريق
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم فريق مشتق من الفعل فرق يفرق فريقا وفروقا وفرقاناً، ويعني التمييز بين الشيئين أو الفصل بينهما، ومنه قول الله تعالى: {فَرَقَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ بَيْنَ النَّاسِ}، ويستخدم في الإسلام للدلالة على التمييز بين الحق والباطل أو بين الإيمان والكفر.

in_urdu.name: فریق
in_urdu.long_meaning: فریق نام عربی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے فرق یا اختلاف کرنا۔ یہ نام اسلامی تقویم میں اہم سمجھا جاتا ہے کیونکہ یہ حق اور باطل کے درمیان فرق کرنے کی یاد دلاتا ہے۔ اس کا استعمال مسلم معاشرے میں ایک اچھے اور مضبوط نام کے طور پر کیا جاتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: फ़रीक
in_hindi.meaning: अंतर या भेद करने का अर्थ
in_hindi.long_meaning: फ़रीक नाम की उत्पत्ति अरबी भाषा से हुई है, जिसका अर्थ है अंतर करना या भेद करना। इस नाम का महत्व इस्लामी परंपरा में है क्योंकि यह सत्य और असत्य के बीच अंतर करने की याद दिलाता है। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में यह नाम एक अच्छे और मजबूत नाम के रूप में प्रयोग किया जाता है।

in_pashto.name: فریق
in_pashto.long_meaning: فریق نوم د عربی ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې معنی یې د توپير يا بيلتونکی دی. دا نوم د افغان او پښتنو په ميراث کې يو مهم نوم ګڼل کيږي، ځکه چې دا د حق او باطل تر منځ د توپير يادونه کوي. په پښتنو ټولنه کې دا نوم د يو ښه او مضبوط نوم په توګه کارول کيږي.

in_english.name: Fareeq
in_english.long_meaning: The name Fareeq originates from the Arabic root 'ف-ر-ق' which means to separate, distinguish or discriminate. In Islamic tradition, it signifies the separation between right and wrong, truth and falsehood. The Quran mentions 'faraq' in various contexts, emphasizing the importance of discernment. Historically, the name has been used across Muslim cultures, symbolizing wisdom and clarity of judgment.

pronunciation.hindi: फ़रीक का उच्चारण (फ - अ - र - ई - क)
pronunciation.pashto: د فریق تلفظ (ف - ا - ر - ی - ق)

In a societal context, it may also be a reminder of the importance of individuality and personal identity within a larger cultural or religious group.
data.spiritual_significance: In the spiritual sense, the name Fareeq holds great significance for Muslims. It reminds us of the importance of distinguishing between right and wrong, truth and falsehood, and good deeds and bad deeds. We are called upon to separate ourselves from sin and evil, and to strive towards righteousness and virtue. The name also has a deeper spiritual meaning, as it can be seen as a reminder of the Islamic belief in the Day of Judgment, when every soul will be separated from sin and rewarded or punished accordingly. Ultimately, the name Fareeq serves as a call for Muslims to distinguish themselves through good deeds and virtuous living, and to strive towards spiritual growth and development.
